beats.context: Free storage Gmail offered at launch, roughly 250 to 500 times what rivals gave.

beats.note: Google's founders had a tradition of outlandish April Fools' jokes, and a gigabyte of email sounded preposterous.

beats.text: Launch capacity was 10,000 users on 300 old machines.
beats.note: Per the AP report, that exclusivity drove demand for invitations.

beats.text: Google opened it to everyone in 2007.
beats.note: For years, the only way in was to be invited.

beats.name: Paul Buchheit
beats.role: Led the project, internally codenamed Caribou.

beats.text: The date was the joke. The gigabyte was not.

beats.line: Gmail launched as a prank and became the standard.
